name: workiq
description: Full WorkIQ tool surface for Microsoft 365 — agentic queries via ask plus direct reads and writes across mail, calendar, Teams, files, people, and Planner. Organized as a hub-and-domain skill hierarchy: a tool-surface hub routes to one domain skill per M365 surface, plus cross-domain workflows and always-on trust and safety rules.

interface.shortDescription: Ask and act across your Microsoft 365 data
interface.longDescription: WorkIQ connects agents to Microsoft 365. Ask questions grounded in your mail, meetings, Teams messages, files, and people — then act on the answers. Domain skills cover each surface end to end, with trust and safety rules that bind across all of them.
defaultPrompt: Ask about your email, meetings, Teams messages, documents, or people
